tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, taken live for real customer bookings.
Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) with secure authentication, separating admin and end-user workflows across the platform.
Built a full-stack trading platform across three services: marketing site, trading dashboard, and Express API using JWT-based authentication and Joi request validation.
Delivered a full-featured Point of Sale (POS) system for a restaurant client using Angular, C#, and MS SQL Server, deploying the system on Azure.
kit.cover_letter: I am writing to apply for the Software Engineer Intern position at Coinbase India Services. As an MCA student at PES University with practical full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to building crypto-forward products and features. During my internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, implementing secure authentication and role-based access control. Additionally, I delivered a full-featured Point of Sale system for a restaurant client utilizing Angular, C#, MS SQL Server, and Azure deployment. In my personal projects, such as Zenvest, I developed a full-stack trading platform across multiple services, integrating JWT authentication, API request validation, and proxy-based third-party data fetching. My background in developing scalable web applications, RESTful APIs, and cloud-deployed systems aligns well with the technical challenges described in your posting. I look forward to the opportunity to bring my software engineering skills to your team.

screening_answers.why_this_company: Coinbase is seeking software engineer interns to build the next generation of crypto-forward products and features while solving unique, large-scale, and highly complex technical problems within web constraints.
screening_answers.why_this_role: The Software Engineer Intern role matches my background in full-stack development, backend systems, and web application architecture, leveraging my experience with Node.js, Express, Angular, and cloud deployments.
screening_answers.why_you: I bring hands-on full-stack development experience from my internship at Sunflower Trip where I built and deployed production-ready applications, along with robust project experience including Zenvest and StaySphere using Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.

screening_answers.relocation: Relocation preference should be confirmed with the candidate.
